title: Xeno-free, chemically defined and scalable monolayer differentiation protocol for retinal pigment epithelial cells
protocol: Thaw 1 vial of Biolaminin at 4°C.
Prepare a Biolaminin solution (1:5) in DPBS to obtain 20 μg/ml.
Add 350 μl of the Biolaminin solution per well.
Incubate the plate with Biolaminin for 24 h at 4°C.
Remove the Biolaminin solution from the wells.
Wash each well with 1 ml of DPBS.
Add 1 ml of NutriStem hPSC XF medium with Rho-kinase inhibitor (10 μM) per well.
Place the plate at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment until cells are ready to be seeded.
Warm DPBS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment.
Warm TrypLE Select Enzyme at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment.
Warm NutriStem hPSC XF medium at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment.
Warm NutriStem hPSC XF medium with Rho-kinase inhibitor at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment.
Remove media from a confluent well of hPSC.
Carefully wash cells with 1 ml of DPBS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Add 350 μl of TrypLE Select Enzyme per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a 5% O₂/5% CO₂ environment for 4 min.
Remove TrypLE Select Enzyme solution carefully.
Add 500 μl of NutriStem hPSC XF medium to the center of the well to detach cells.
Gently resuspend the detached cells with the medium and transfer them to a 15 ml tube.
Repeat the process by adding another 500 μl of medium to collect all remaining cells in the well.
Measure the cell concentration.
Take the required amount of cell suspension to seed 2.4x10^4 cells/cm^2 in 1 ml of NutriStem hPSC XF medium with Rho-kinase inhibitor per well and place it at 37°C 5% O₂/5% CO₂ for 24 hours.
Replace the medium with 1 ml of growth factor-free NutriStem hPSC XF medium per well and change the incubation conditions to 37°C 21% O₂/5% CO₂.
Feed the cells three times a week with 1.4 ml per well of pre-warmed (at 37°C 21% O₂/5% CO₂) growth factor-free NutriStem hPSC XF medium.
From day 6 to day 30 after seeding, add recombinant Activin A to the medium to achieve a concentration of 100 ng/ml.
Remove the media from the well.
Wash the cells with 1 ml of DPBS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Add 350 μl of TrypLE Select Enzyme per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C 21% O₂/5% CO₂ for 12 min.
Remove the TrypLE Select Enzyme solution.
Add 500 μl of NutriStem hPSC XF medium directly to the center of the well to detach the cells.
Thoroughly resuspend the cells with the medium and transfer them to a 15 ml tube through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Repeat the process with another 500 μl of medium to collect all remaining cells in the well.
Measure cell concentration.

Take the required amount of cell suspension to obtain the number of cells needed to seed 7x10⁴ cells/cm² (1 to 20 dilution) in a total volume of 1 ml of NutriStem hPSC XF medium per well in the previously prepared plate and place it at 37°C 21% O₂/5% CO₂.
